procedure.method: Read only the explicitly pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, helper scripts, ratio policy, five native-evidence manifests and fifteen poster assets. Verified the 27 supplied byte/hash pins. The packet supplies no source assets and no protected-layout manifests, so both procedure lists are empty. After reading the native-evidence manifests, I invoked tools.view_image with detail=original on each exact pinned poster path through functions.exec, and emitted each returned image with image(..., original). The fifteen individual viewing calls occurred sequentially in packet order: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. All fifteen displayed images were visually inspected before the first transcription judgment, image score or set-diversity score. No revisit was needed. PNG IHDR metadata independently confirms native dimensions of 1024x1536 and RGB color type 2; PNG chunk inspection confirms no transparency chunk. No source-asset opens, protected-layout reads or runtime thread ID are invented. I did not spawn, fork, resume, inspect peer reviews or follow unpinned paths embedded in manifests. session_id is null; runtime provenance belongs to the runner.
